question: Who among the following was conferred the Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 67th National Film Awards ceremony?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajinikanth.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The most recent recipient of the award is **actor Rajinikanth** who was honored at the 67th National Film Awards ceremony.
 
• Superstar **Rajinikanth on October 25 received the prestigious 51st Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 67th National Film Awards c**eremony for his outstanding contribution to the world of Indian cinema**.**
 
• The award ceremony was held at New Delhi'**s Vigyan Bhawan. **Vice President Venkaiah Naidu handed the prizes to the awardees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest award in the field of cinema. It is presented annually at the National Film Awards ceremony by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• Instituted in 1969 when presented to Devika Rani, the Dadasaheb Phalke Award was introduced by the Government of India to commemorate Dadasaheb Phalke's.
